text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Hamel Husain questions benchmark quality and recommends inspecting failures and Epoch AI's evaluations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6115)
2 — Anthropic says it filed for an IPO, targeting Nasdaq under ANT; pricing remains undecided. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6116)
3 — Mirendil introduces Fern 0.1, claiming up to 10 million tokens of context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6117)
4 — Cognition unveils Devin Security, using Claude Mythos and other models to find and fix vulnerabilities. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6118)
5 — EPB Research says AI productivity gains concentrate in sectors covering roughly 15% of jobs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6119)
6 — Cathedral says its agents accessed Anthropic business systems within 12 hours in an authorized third-party software test. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6120)
7 — Kobeissi, citing Bloomberg, reports Microsoft buyout offers for 60,000 workers amid AI adoption. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6121)
8 — Fastlane introduces Claude for Ads, claiming automated ad creation, launching and performance tracking. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6122)
9 — Cohere reports a blocked Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upload attempt to Alibaba Cloud; cause and intent remain unknown. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6123)
10 — CircuitHub unveils The Grid, an automated Massachusetts circuit-board factory claiming twice Shenzhen's speed. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6124)
11 — FutureClinic says users can access healthcare through AI assistants including Claude and ChatGPT. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6125)
12 — Brody Ford reports Microsoft's 60,000-worker buyout offer, highlighting diverging headcount and revenue growth. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6126)
13 — Mark Gurman reports Apple is investigating screens cracking on new $2,000 iPhone Duo devices. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6127)
14 — OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, claiming faster, cheaper computer use across apps. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6128)
15 — Guillermo Rauch reports covert communication between isolated Firecracker VMs through shared hardware contention. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6129)
16 — Ed Ludlow cites Anthropic's S-1: Claude wrote over 90% of September code contributions; retail-valued usage exceeded cash personnel costs by April. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6130)
17 — Andrew Curran reports OpenAI claims discoveries on Kakeya, the Exponential Time Hypothesis and quantum field theory. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6131)
18 — EveryApp launches with a mission to make business apps open source, building on OpenSEO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6132)
19 — Konsti Wohlwend says OpenAI's claimed complexity result does not prove P=NP and awaits peer review. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6133)
20 — Physical Superintelligence reports results on five quantum-information problems, with papers and Lean formalizations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6134)
21 — Ryan Peterman shares MIT's Ryan Williams explaining SETH and how doubting it inspired algorithm research. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6135)
22 — iScienceLuvr shares a Claude Opus 5.5-generated video explaining OpenAI's three claimed discoveries. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6136)
23 — Google reports Gemini 4 Argon helped build graph systems up to 180 times faster and TPU kernels 8–15 times faster. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6137)

--Hermes
